title: US State Privacy Laws Policy Template
metaDescription: Comprehensive template for creating state privacy law compliance policies covering Texas, Virginia, Colorado, and other US state requirements.
description: Create compliant privacy policies that meet US state privacy law requirements. This template covers major state laws including Texas Data Privacy and Security Act, Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act, Colorado Privacy Act, and more.

sections.heading: Introduction and Scope
sections.content:
This Privacy Policy describes how [COMPANY_NAME] collects, uses, and protects your personal information in compliance with applicable US state privacy laws, including but not limited to the Texas Data Privacy and Security Act (TDPSA), Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA), Colorado Privacy Act (CPA), Connecticut Data Privacy Act (CTDPA), and other state-specific requirements.

Effective Date: [EFFECTIVE_DATE]
Last Updated: [LAST_UPDATED]

This policy applies to residents of states with specific privacy law protections and supplements our general privacy practices.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content:
We collect the following categories of personal information as defined by applicable state privacy laws:

• Identifiers (name, email, phone number, IP address)
• Commercial information (purchase history, preferences)
• Internet activity (browsing history, search history)
• Geolocation data
• Professional information
• Biometric information (if applicable)
• Sensitive personal information including:
  - Precise geolocation
  - Racial or ethnic origin
  - Health information
  - Financial account information

[COMPANY_NAME] collects this information through [COLLECTION_METHODS]. We recommend using privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser to limit tracking when browsing websites.

placeholders.label: Data Collection Methods
placeholders.defaultValue: direct interactions, website cookies, third-party partners, and automated technologies

sections.heading: How We Use Personal Information
sections.content:
We process personal information for the following business purposes:

• Providing and maintaining our services
• Processing transactions and payments
• Customer support and communication
• Marketing and advertising (with consent where required)
• Legal compliance and fraud prevention
• Business operations and analytics

For sensitive personal information, we obtain explicit consent where required by applicable state laws. We do not sell sensitive personal information without consent.

Processing is based on:
• Consent
• Contract performance
• Legitimate business interests
• Legal compliance

sections.heading: Information Sharing and Disclosure
sections.content:
We may share personal information with:

• Service providers and vendors
• Business partners (with consent)
• Legal authorities when required by law
• In connection with business transactions

[COMPANY_NAME] [SELLING_STATUS] personal information to third parties. If we engage in targeted advertising, we provide opt-out mechanisms as required by state laws.

We require all third parties to maintain appropriate security measures and use personal information only for specified purposes.

sections.heading: Your Privacy Rights
sections.content:
Depending on your state of residence, you may have the following rights:

**Right to Know/Access:** Request information about personal data collection, use, and sharing
**Right to Delete:** Request deletion of personal information
**Right to Correct:** Request correction of inaccurate personal information
**Right to Opt-Out:** Opt-out of sale, targeted advertising, or profiling
**Right to Data Portability:** Receive personal information in a portable format
**Right to Non-Discrimination:** Not be discriminated against for exercising privacy rights

**Sensitive Data Rights:** Additional protections for sensitive personal information including explicit consent requirements.

To exercise these rights, contact us at [CONTACT_EMAIL] or [CONTACT_PHONE]. We will respond within the timeframes required by applicable state law (typically 45 days).

sections.heading: State-Specific Provisions
sections.content:
**Texas Residents (TDPSA):** Additional rights for processing sensitive personal information and biometric data protections.

**Virginia Residents (VCDPA):** Right to appeal our decision regarding your privacy rights request.

**Colorado Residents (CPA):** Right to opt-out of profiling for decisions with legal effects.

**Connecticut Residents (CTDPA):** Enhanced protections for processing personal information of minors.

**California Residents:** This policy supplements our CCPA privacy notice with additional state-specific protections.

For residents of other states with comprehensive privacy laws, similar protections may apply as laws take effect.

sections.heading: Data Security and Retention
sections.content:
We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect personal information, including:

• Encryption of data in transit and at rest
• Access controls and authentication
• Regular security assessments
• Employee training on data protection
• Incident response procedures

**Data Retention:** We retain personal information only as long as necessary for the purposes outlined in this policy or as required by law. Retention periods vary based on:
• Type of information
• Purpose of processing
• Legal requirements
• Your relationship with our services

**Data Breach Notification:** We will notify affected individuals and relevant authorities of data breaches as required by applicable state laws.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.content:
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without parental consent. For states with enhanced protections for minors (such as Connecticut), we implement additional safeguards for processing information of individuals under 18.

If you believe we have collected information from a child without proper consent, please contact us immediately at [CONTACT_EMAIL].

**Additional Teen Protections:** Some state laws provide enhanced protections for teenagers, including restrictions on targeted advertising and data sharing.

sections.heading: Updates and Contact Information
sections.content:
We may update this policy to reflect changes in our practices or applicable laws. Material changes will be communicated through [NOTIFICATION_METHOD].

**Contact Information:**
Privacy Officer: [PRIVACY_OFFICER]
Email: [CONTACT_EMAIL]
Phone: [CONTACT_PHONE]
Mailing Address:
[COMPANY_ADDRESS]

**For Privacy Rights Requests:**
Online Portal: [PORTAL_URL]
Toll-Free Number: [TOLL_FREE_NUMBER]

We are committed to protecting your privacy and will work with you to address any concerns about our data practices.
